name: Zastiga
description: Zastiga was a planet in the Zastiga system in the Kallea sector on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, frequented by traders. It was the location of a secret Rebel Alliance meeting where Chancellor Mon Mothma and Admiral Gial Ackbar revealed to senior Rebel leaders that the Galactic Empire was constructing a second Death Star.
